profile.summary: Certica Solutions is a company that provides data compliance and accountability software for K-12 education. It also offers standards-aligned assessment content and learning analytics tools used by school districts. It was acquired by Instructure in December 2020.

sources.title: Instructure to Acquire Certica Solutions to Make Learning Personal for Every Student

review.notes: Certica Solutions is a K-12 data compliance and assessment vendor headquartered in Wakefield, MA (Brook Venture page), matching the agenda name, location and a Technology Services software license. The summary is neutral and supported; the Instructure press release announced the acquisition on Dec 10, 2020 (closing date not stated there, but expected by year end).
